rights.summary: Alexander Alekhine died in 1946 (author copyright expired in EU/Germany on 2016-12-31 under UrhG § 64). However, this English edition was translated from the French manuscripts by J. du Mont (d. 1956) and M. E. Goldstein (d. 1966), so the English translation prose remains protected in Germany/EU until 2036-12-31 (UrhG §§ 3, 64, 65) and the McKay 1965/1972 edition bears an All Rights Reserved notice. Therefore zero verbatim book prose or OCR dumps are retained; only non-copyrightable factual chess data (PGN, SAN mainline moves, validated variation trees, diagram/key FENs, event/player/opening/result metadata) and freshly authored ChessAZ technical coaching summaries are stored.

frontMatter.note: In the printed Summary of Results (p. vii), Tournaments Won (235) + Drawn (119) + Lost (51) sums to 405 while Played is printed as 406 (1922 London reports 15 played: 8 won, 7 drawn; 1923 Margate 7: 3,3,1; 1923 Carlsbad 17: 9,5,3; 1924 New York 20: 6,12,2; etc.).

frontMatterErrata.note: Summary of Results (p. vii) prints Tournaments Played=406 while Won(235)+Drawn(119)+Lost(51)=405; Index of Openings (p. 265) lists Queen's Gambit Declined twice on p. 50/185 and Ruy Lopez p. 48 twice.
